content.text: This clause set meets the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package sits at the preferred position. Section 14.2 gives us ownership of Deliverables with an express Vendor assignment (plus personnel assignments and further-assurance cooperation); Section 14.1 confirms we retain all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right to deliver the Services; Section 14.3 lets Vendor retain only Vendor Technology and routes embedded Vendor Technology through the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify, create derivative works and permit contractors to support it; and Section 14.4 bars joint ownership absent a signed instrument and keeps feedback voluntary and non-identifying. Section 15.1 reinforces our data position by prohibiting sale, advertising use, cross-customer combination and model training without our written consent. No assignment of our IP or data to Vendor, no Vendor-owned deliverables without a licence back, and no joint ownership. Minor point noted only: the Section 14.1 processing right includes "improve the Services", though it is confined to providing the Services for us and is further limited by Section 15.1 — not a deviation.
